name: Abigail Potter
outcome: not filed - a face exists and cannot be tied to her
detail: The 2016 Talisman carries an underclassman portrait cell printed ABBY POTTER on p. 285 (grid position row 2, column 1; PDF page 144, xref 18221, 510x510), and Abby is the ordinary short form of Abigail. It was not cut, because the Herald shows more than one Abby Potter at WKU in these years and the underclassman cell fits the wrong one. The Herald of 16 April 2015 has 'Bowling Green senior Abby Potter, Greek Week chair and Kappa Delta sorority member', a junior in its stories of 19 March and 3 April 2014, so that Abby Potter graduated in spring 2015 and cannot be an underclassman in a book made in 2015-16. A second Abby Potter is the Herald's own photojournalist, credited 'Abby Potter/HERALD' through 2016 and 2017 and described on 16 September 2018 as 'WKU graduate Abby Potter of Bowling Green ... A photojournalism major' - she was an undergraduate in 2015-16 and fits the cell. Nothing in the Judicial Council record gives a major, a hometown or a class year that would separate them. The Herald names the justice twice, on 17 and 21 April 2015, both times as 'Judicial Council member Abby Potter' quoted on the Richey election appeal, and photographs her neither time.
checked: 2016 Talisman back index and portrait grids; wkuherald.com post search for 'Abby Potter' and 'Abigail Potter'; data/herald-photos.json caption index (109 Potter captions, none naming her); WKU img_facstaff directory for handle abigail.potter827 (placeholder, no photograph on file)
